title: Product Owner Payments (f/m/d)
description:
A growing payments company is looking for a Product Owner for its merchant payments platform. You join a cross-functional team of seven engineers and a designer.

What you'll do
- Own and prioritise the backlog for card and wallet acceptance
- Turn input from risk, compliance and merchants into user stories with clear acceptance criteria
- Run refinement, sprint reviews and release planning with the engineering lead
- Define product KPIs and report adoption and conversion to management

What you bring
- 4+ years as Product Owner, Product Manager or Business Analyst, ideally in payments or banking
- Experience with APIs and event-driven systems; confident with SQL for your own analyses
- Hands-on Scrum with Jira and Confluence
- Fluent English; German is helpful but not required
